BiblicalUsage: Helkath is a city of Asher, named on the border of the tribe and again as a city given to the Levites with its suburbs. It is a border town that becomes a Levites' town.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a border town given to the Levites is a border kept holy. Helkath belongs to Asher and to the Levites, and the gift is the point.
